info.name: Blinkit Instant Delivery API
info.description:
# Blinkit Instant Grocery Delivery API Documentation

Complete, production-ready REST API for the Blinkit-style instant delivery platform.

### 🚀 Quick Start Guide
1. Make sure your backend is running at `http://localhost:3000`
2. Open **Authentication > 1. Request OTP** to send an SMS/Dev OTP to your phone.
3. Open **Authentication > 2. Verify OTP** with OTP `123456` (or the console dev OTP) - your `accessToken` and `refreshToken` will be saved automatically!
4. Use **Store & Catalog > Catalog Home** or **Products > List Products** to browse the catalog.
5. Add items to cart with **Cart > Add / Update Cart Item**, check out with **Orders > Create Order**, and track live delivery with **Orders > Track Order**.

### 🔑 Environment Variables
* `baseUrl`: `http://localhost:3000/api`
* `accessToken`: Populated automatically after OTP verification or Admin Login
* `adminToken`: Populated automatically after Admin Login
* `storeId`: Default store ID `6ad8eebdfce460c6fde26605`
* `x-store-id`: Sent in headers for store-specific operations (Cart, Catalog)

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Customer Phone OTP login flow, Admin email/password login, token rotation, and session management.

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the customer's phone number. In development mode, the OTP is printed to the backend console (default dev OTP is `123456`).

**Body Parameters:**
* `phone` (string, required): 10 to 15 digit mobile phone number.

exec: console.log('Saved accessToken and refreshToken to collection variables');

request.description:
Verifies the 6-digit OTP and authenticates the user. If the user is new, an account is automatically created with the provided `name`.

**Test Script:** Automatically saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` to Postman collection variables upon 200 OK.
Exchange a valid `refreshToken` for a brand new `accessToken` and rotated `refreshToken`.
Authenticates an administrator using email & password. Automatically stores `adminToken` in collection variables.
Revokes the active refresh token session for the authenticated user.
Invalidates all active refresh tokens and sessions across all user devices.

item.name: 2. Dark Stores & Serviceability
item.description: Dark store discovery, GPS serviceability checks, delivery radii, and store operating hours.

request.description: Returns all active dark stores in the network with their coordinates, address, and delivery parameters.
Finds the nearest dark stores sorted by proximity to the provided GPS coordinates.

Checks whether a specific dark store can deliver to the user's location.

**Returns:**
* `serviceable`: boolean (is user within deliveryRadiusKm)
* `distanceKm`: distance in kilometers
* `isOpen`: boolean (is store open based on opensAt/closesAt)
* `etaMinutes`: estimated delivery time (e.g. 10-15 mins)
* `deliveryFee`, `minOrderAmount`
Returns detailed configuration for a specific dark store including delivery fees and operating hours.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Blinkit Dark Store - Koramangala",
  "phone": "9876543299",
  "address": "80 Feet Road, 4th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru",
  "location": {
    "lat": 12.9352,
    "lng": 77.6245
  },
  "deliveryRadiusKm": 15,
  "minOrderAmount": 9900,
  "deliveryFee": 2500,
  "freeDeliveryAbove": 19900,
  "handlingFee": 400,
  "avgPrepMinutes": 10,
  "opensAt": "00:00",
  "closesAt": "23:59",
  "timezone": "Asia/Kolkata"
}

request.description: Creates a new dark store location. Requires Admin role.
Updates store configuration such as delivery radius or hours. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 3. Catalog Home & Categories
item.description: Homepage feeds, product rails, categories, and subcategories.

request.description: Fetches the homepage catalog layout for the customer app containing category rails and product lists tailored to the active dark store.
Returns top-level grocery categories with their high-resolution icons and banner images.
Fetches subcategories for a given parent category.
Returns details of a specific category.
Creates a new category. Requires Admin role.
Updates category properties. Requires Admin role.
Soft deletes a category. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 4. Products Catalog & Search
item.description: Search, filter, pagination, price range, and stock management.

query.description: Filter products by dark store ID

request.description: Search and filter products across categories, prices, and stock availability.
Returns product details, HD image gallery, nutritional info, unit, price in paise, and MRP.

{
  "storeId": "{{storeId}}",
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "name": "Amul Taaza Homogenised Toned Milk 1L",
  "description": "Pasteurised toned milk with 3.0% fat and 8.5% SNF.",
  "brand": "Amul",
  "unit": "1 L",
  "mrp": 7400,
  "price": 6800,
  "stock": 50,
  "maxPerOrder": 6,

  "images": [
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1550583724-b2692b85b150?w=500&q=80"

request.description: Creates a new grocery SKU in a dark store. Note: all prices and MRPs are in **paise** (1 INR = 100 paise). Requires Admin role.
Updates inventory levels for a product. Can specify absolute `stock` or relative `delta` (e.g. `delta: -5`). Requires Admin role.
Updates pricing, limits, or availability. Requires Admin role.
Soft deletes a product. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 5. Shopping Cart
item.description: Persistent shopping cart operations with store context, coupon application, and bill calculation.

request.description: Fetches current shopping cart for user in the given dark store with line items, applied coupon, and full bill breakdown (itemTotal, discount, deliveryFee, handlingFee, grandTotal).
Sets the exact quantity of an item in the cart. Setting `quantity: 0` removes the item from the cart.
Removes an item completely from the active cart.
Validates and applies a promotional coupon code (e.g. `WELCOME50`, `SAVE100`, `FESTIVE20`) to the active cart, updating the bill discount.
Removes the currently applied coupon from the active cart.
Clears all items and applied coupons from the cart.

item.name: 6. Saved Delivery Addresses
item.description: Manage customer delivery addresses (Home, Work, Other) with GPS coordinates.

request.description: Returns all saved addresses for the authenticated customer.
Saves a new delivery address with geo coordinates for serviceability checks.
Updates an existing saved address.
Sets the selected address as the primary default address for checkout.
Deletes a saved address.

item.name: 7. Orders & Live Tracking
item.description: Order placement, history, live delivery status, cancellation, and reordering.

request.description:
Places a new instant delivery order using items in the active cart and the selected delivery address.

**Parameters:**
* `addressId` (string, optional if deliveryAddress provided)
* `paymentMethod`: `COD`, `UPI`, `CARD`, `WALLET`
* `couponCode`: optional promo code
* `notes`: optional delivery instructions
Fetches past orders placed by the authenticated customer with order numbers and status.
Returns complete itemized receipt, pricing, delivery address, and payment status.
Returns real-time tracking progression (placed -> confirmed -> packing -> out_for_delivery -> delivered), rider name/phone, and estimated arrival time.
Cancels an order if it is still in `placed` or `confirmed` stage and restores inventory.
Copies all items from a past order into the current active cart for fast 1-click reordering.
Advances the order lifecycle. Valid statuses: `placed`, `confirmed`, `packing`, `out_for_delivery`, `delivered`, `cancelled`. Requires Admin role.
Retrieves the dark store fulfillment queue. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 8. Coupons & Promotions
item.description: Discount vouchers, minimum order thresholds, and coupon administration.

request.description: Returns currently active coupons available for the dark store.
Lists all promotional coupons created in the system. Requires Admin role.
Creates a new coupon. `type`: `PERCENTAGE` or `FLAT`. Note: all currency values are in paise. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 9. User Profile
item.description: Manage customer profile info, name, and email.

request.description: Returns profile details (name, phone, email, role) of the currently authenticated user.
Updates user's display name or email address.
Soft deletes the user account and revokes active sessions.

item.name: 10. Admin Dashboard & Inventory Alerts
item.description: Business analytics, total GMV, order volume, and low stock warnings.

request.description: Returns executive metrics: Total GMV revenue, total orders placed, average order value (AOV), active user count, and top-selling products. Requires Admin role.

query.description: Trigger alert if stock is less than this value

request.description: Returns SKUs that need restocking in the dark store. Requires Admin role.
Search and paginate through customer and admin accounts. Requires Admin role.
